description: This Java class 'ProductKeywordsController' is a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing product keywords, including displaying, adding, removing, and paginating keywords associated with products in the admin interface.

classes.name: ProductKeywordsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for handling product keyword management functions in the admin area.

methods.name: displayKeywords
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product keywords page, loading product data and setting up the model.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new keyword to a product in a specific language, updating the product description accordingly.

methods.name: removeKeyword
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove a specific keyword from a product in a specific language, updating the product descriptions.

methods.name: pageKeywords
methods.description: Handles POST requests to paginate and return product keywords as JSON data for display.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper to set up menu context for views.
